data.title: Action
data.description: The available actions in this field are outlined in the [descriptions] table where the table field equals ACTIONTYPES.

data.title: Contra Ticker Symbol
data.description: The contra ticker associated with the action; if applicable.

data.title: Date
data.description: The date of the corporate action.

data.title: Ticker Symbol
data.description: The ticker is a unique identifier for a security in the database. Where a company is delisted and the ticker subsequently recycled for use by a different company; we utilise that ticker for the currently active company and append a number to the ticker of the delisted company. The [actions] table provides a record of historical ticker changes.

data.title: Contra Issuer Name
data.description: The name of the contra issuer associated with the contra ticker.

data.title: Value
data.description: The available values in this field are outlined in the [descriptions] table where the table field equals ACTIONTYPES.
